notes: One run per arm; timing noise is not estimated by independent repetitions.
Before is the immutable mapped base; after opens the updatable directory with an empty delta.
Recall is measured before updates; randomized and 50k tests cover updates and consolidation.
HMS operation batches contain 1% of ids and include commit; hnswlib uses its harness save_index flush.
Before QPS uses the existing ann-qgraph aggregate timer; after and hnswlib use per-query timers. The separately timed Criterion comparison uses identical query timing for both versions.
The SIFT recall values match at all 20 ef/rerank configurations. The single run shows 2.9–4.6% lower QPS through the update API; no independent-round noise estimate is available.
HMS cold-start is open plus first query with index-file page cache dropped; hnswlib cold_start_s includes interpreter startup and query-file loading, following the existing harness boundary.
The final dimension-keyed scratch reuse fix is covered by Criterion and regression tests. SIFT serving/update measurements use the preceding commit; they involve only one dimension.

Final source 3c4ca53 includes explicit ownership unlock, id-table checksums, bounded manifest reads, dense-id mapping bypass, single query validation, search_into, and delta routing reachability. The final Criterion section measures that source; initial and buffer-fix measurements are retained. The single SIFT comparison precedes these fixes.
The final Criterion pair is 24.97 us immutable versus 24.85 us buffered clean search (-0.5%); the identical immutable binary ranged 23.66–24.97 us across runs, so no speedup is claimed.

After the measured query-path revision 3c4ca53, a4ec72f changes only header-version recognition and its tests: unknown versions are refused before fixed-size validation. No wire bytes or query algorithms change; this final header guard was not benchmarked.

source.note: The graph was built before serving. The updatable binary was rebuilt with bounded tombstone compensation before any serving or update measurements. Rebasing onto main changed only docs/benchmarks/COMPARISON.md; the recorded invocation retains its original commit label.
